progressTimingInterpretation: Monotonic milliseconds from request start to observer receipt. Reasoning text, partial tool input and executable tool input are distinct; none proves native paint or tool completion. Replayed arrivals include detachment time.

startupTiming.interpretation: Provider intervals use provider timestamps, not queue or cold-start measurements. Attempt-to-handler is a signed cross-runtime wall-clock delta and may include clock skew. Process uptime is process age, not initialization duration.
